variants.title: 窓辺の小さな調合室
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one tall portrait 9:19.5 full-bleed rank-5 completed potion workshop illustration for an iPhone focus app. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its atmospheric detailed pixel art, visible stepped edges and clustered pixels, indigo shadows, warm amber pools of light and small turquoise accents. Match pixel treatment for woman and background. No UI, lettering, status bar, borders or collage.
USER CORRECTION: previous concepts were far too cluttered. Significantly simplify the composition and object count. This should feel like a comfortable personal workplace, not a sprawling factory. Only one single-storey room, one modest oak workbench, ONE beautiful medium-sized copper-and-glass brewing apparatus with one luminous mint glass vessel and one connected coil. One short shelf with about six bottles. Two herb pots. One warm desk lamp. Keep broad calm areas of wall, floor and window; roughly half the composition should be quiet visual breathing room. No masses of bottles, tangled pipes, galleries, ladders, bridges, extra storeys, giant machinery, or many tiny light sources. Rank 5 feels lovingly upgraded, polished and functional, not extravagant or empty. A small dark-haired young adult woman in a practical apron sits working with a notebook and small flask near the lower right; only 12-15% of the image height, supporting figure, anatomically believable, same pixel texture, no smooth anime cutout. Environment dominant. Full scene shown, no unlock masks. Strong simple silhouettes, restful lofi mood.
SCENE A: A cozy attic potion room with a tall gently arched window centered in the upper half, calm blue-hour sky and soft distant tree silhouettes beyond it. Window and deep blue plaster wall give generous negative space. A broad oak workbench occupies lower third; brewing apparatus sits at its left end and small working woman at its right end. One small wooden bottle shelf on left wall, one hanging herb bunch. A few visible ceiling beams. Intimate room with clear floor space, simple and inviting.
